stock_outlook.thesis_summary: WSP Global is one of the highest-conviction longs on the Canadian market — a compounding machine with exceptional backlog visibility and direct exposure to the infrastructure super-cycle.
key_drivers: 14% revenue CAGR over 5 years through disciplined M&A and organic growth
Backlog at 3.2x annual revenue providing exceptional forward visibility
Expanding margins as recent acquisitions integrate and fixed-price contracts reprice
Long-term infrastructure super-cycle aligns directly with WSP service lines

final_recommendation.executive_summary: WSP Global is one of the highest-conviction longs on the Canadian market. The global engineering and consulting firm is a compounding machine — it has grown revenue at a 14% CAGR over five years through disciplined M&A and organic growth in infrastructure, environment, and transportation consulting. Backlog grew 11% year-over-year and now stands at 3.2x annual revenue, providing exceptional visibility. Margins are expanding as the company integrates recent acquisitions and benefits from fixed-price contract pricing power. The long-term infrastructure super-cycle (energy transition, climate adaptation, digital infrastructure) directly aligns with WSP's service lines. This is a core long-term hold for a TFSA account — the tax-free compounding amplifies the thesis significantly.
final_recommendation.cio_rationale: All five Pass 1 agents were bullish. The Pass 2 agents reached near-consensus at BUY with only the risk advisor noting some acquisition integration risk. This is exceptional alignment. I set confidence at 88 — the 12 percentage points of uncertainty reflects the premium valuation (33x forward earnings) and sensitivity to global infrastructure spending cycles.

layer2_context.portfolio_fit_rationale: Strong capital-gains profile with low correlation to existing Financials-heavy holdings. Would improve portfolio diversification and projected return.

stock_fundamentals.business_description: WSP Global Inc. provides engineering and professional services in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Environment, Industry, Resources, and Power & Energy sectors across 40+ countries. One of the world's largest engineering consulting firms with over 65,000 employees.
